prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Employee welcome drawers, Two-drawer box. Two separate shallow drawers slide from one rigid cabinet. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Fine linen-textured wrapping paper, Ivory and forest green, Two-colour print and debossed border, restrained botanical line drawing. EMPTY insert: a stationery drawer and an accessory drawer. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Show exactly two drawers with front ribbon pulls, top drawer pulled out farther. No hinged top. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. All views same proportions, artwork locations, number and shape of insert cavities. Neutral warm studio, tactile paper, refined controlled lighting. Never a corrugated mailer, tuck carton, dust flaps or shipping box. Realistic separate assembled rigid walls, straight edges, accurate mating footprints and visible paper thickness. Keep complete objects within each cell. No products inside; focus on the packaging. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
reviewNotes: Five views reviewed: opening, cavity layout and material continuity. Physical sampling required.
